Plexus Corp. earned the Lean Manufacturing Excellence Award from GE Vernova Power Conversion and Storage at its global supplier conference in Shanghai, China.


This honor from the GE Vernova’s Electrification Business Unit recognizes our lean manufacturing and strong continuous improvement culture, rooted in achieving Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost targets over the past two years.


We sincerely thank GE Vernova and look forward to continuing our impactful partnership to create a better world.
